jobs.description: Assembly Technician / Mechanical Assembler  Marcel Hulsen  Strategic Account Manager Engineering & Operations  +31 (0) 40 401 5200  m.hulsen@trinamics.nl  apply_now Mechanical Engineering Junior Horst Mechanical Engineering Junior Horst vacancies.from € 2.900 vacancies.to € 3.700 p/m  Marcel Hulsen  Strategic Account Manager Engineering & Operations  +31 (0) 40 401 5200  m.hulsen@trinamics.nl Are you an assembly technician, mechanical assembler or car/truck mechanic who wants to build large machines with your hands? For a leading international manufacturer of agricultural machinery in Horst (North Limburg), Trinamics is looking for Assembly Technicians to assemble high-quality crop sprayers on the production line. You work day shifts only, from 07:00 to 15:50, in a modern technical production environment. Order volumes are rising sharply with new machine models coming into production, so multiple positions are open and you can start as soon as possible.  vacancies.offer  - Salary indication: € 2,900 - € 3,700 gross per month, depending on experience and qualifications - Day shift only: 07:00 - 15:50 - Travel allowance and 8.33% holiday allowance - Discount on your health insurance - Opportunities for technical and professional development - Personal guidance from Trinamics - Always a permanent job; no temporary projects. - After a pre-agreed period, being taken on directly by our client is a possibility. - An extensive package of secondary employment benefits. - Plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development. Must-haves - A technical background, e.g. as assembly worker, car or truck mechanic, agricultural machinery mechanic or machine builder - Able to read technical drawings and work instructions - Comfortable working with hand tools and power tools - Good command of English (Dutch is not required) - Available to start soon; coming from abroad? Then you have housing arranged before your start ...
